summary.text: William Lawrence is a Republican member of the Kentucky House of Representatives representing District 70, serving since 2021. The legislature's profile lists Lawrence as vice chair of the House Small Business & Information Technology Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, William Lawrence was born on January 19, 1989, and is self-employed.
The profile lists trade school study in industrial maintenance and membership in the Lions Club International, Kiwanis International, and the Historical Society of Mason County.
